thread:
Jordan M.: Quick ping — opened PR #4321 to change orders.amount -> BIGINT and add CONCURRENT index. Target deploy Wed 2025-11-12 09:00 UTC. Can @Ria Patel or @Sam (data-eng) take a look? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321

Jordan M.: Migration SQL:
```
ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN amount TYPE BIGINT USING amount::bigint;
ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN created_at SET DEFAULT now();
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_created_at ON orders(created_at);
```

Ria Patel: :eyes: I'll review schema changes and run migration in staging today. Quick Q — any rows with NULL amount? That cast will fail.

Jordan M.: Good call — added a safe cast in latest commit: `USING COALESCE(amount,0)::bigint` and a short backfill job in the PR description.

Sam (data-eng): I can review the backfill and the pipeline impact. Need to confirm consumer jobs treat amount as int64; looks fine but will run tests. ETA ~3h.

Tara L.: FYI, we should schedule the index build during low-traffic window. We can do CONCURRENTLY but still costly. Ops ping @deploy-bot for maintenance window?

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window request created: MW-2025-11-12-09-00-UTC. Please confirm: https://deployments.redwood.internal/mw/9876

Jordan M.: Confirmed. I'll add rollout plan in PR (canary on 10% traffic for 30m, monitor errors/counter) and note replica considerations. Tagging schema owners: @Ria Patel @Tara L.

Ria Patel: Found one failing test in staging related to casting. Pushed fix to PR. Ran migration on a small subset in staging — success. :white_check_mark:

Sam (data-eng): Reviewed pipelines; backfill job added as Airflow DAG `backfill_orders_amount_v2`. No downstream schema changes required. I opened a test run for the DAG. Approving PR shortly.

Tara L.: Left a comment about explicit downtime note for legacy replicas and ordering of index/backfill. Approving once that's clarified in PR.

Jordan M.: Added note and rollback SQL snippet to PR description:
```
-- rollback
ALTER TABLE orders ALTER COLUMN amount TYPE INTEGER USING (amount::integer);
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_orders_created_at;
```

Sam (data-eng): Approved. :shipit:

Ria Patel: Approved. :thumbsup:

Tara L.: Approved. Merge when CI passes. I'll watch the canary and monitor replicas.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #4321 — all checks green.

Jordan M.: Merged and scheduled migration to run at MW-2025-11-12-09-00-UTC. Thanks all!

Sam (data-eng): Thanks! Will monitor ETL metrics and pipelines post-migration.

Ria Patel: Good job, no incidents observed in staging. Keep an eye on replica lag.

Tara L.: Keeping this thread open during the window. I'll be on-call.
